 GTA 6 Gives Players Two Choices in Hey Arnold Mission 
 GTA 6 Gives Players Two Choices in Hey Arnold Mission
 Emily Johnson 
 Published

 13

 Smallest Font 
 Largest Font 
 Players investigating Brian Heder's missing business associate in Grand Theft Auto VI must make a decision about Arnold during the Hey Arnold! mission. Playing as Jason Duval in Chapter 1, players track the broker from Key Lento to the docks in Maroon Key, where they can either kill him or let him escape.
 According to walkthroughs published by Sportskeeda, Beebom, and EGamers.io, the mission becomes available after completing Pipework. Brian subsequently contacts Jason and requests a meeting at a pool bar in southern Key Lento because Arnold has stopped responding to his calls.
 Advertisement 
 Scroll To Continue with Content 
 The mission requires Jason to collect Brian and Cal before traveling toward a radar station in Maroon Key. Arnold is waiting with his associates when the group arrives, but the confrontation quickly deteriorates after he decides to distance himself from Brian's business.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Guides Players Through the Unwanted Attention Mission 
 Arnold escapes in a vehicle, forcing Jason and Brian to pursue him. During the chase, armed motorcyclists attack the truck, while additional enemies attempt to prevent the pursuit from continuing.
 Players must maintain their distance from Arnold's vehicle and navigate the bridge during the chase. The vehicle automatically performs stunt jumps along the route, which count toward completed stunt jumps and subsequently appear on the map under the Exploration filter, according to EGamers.io.
 After Arnold's vehicle stops, Jason continues the pursuit on foot until reaching the docks. The broker eventually surrenders, and the game presents two available decisions that determine how the encounter ends.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Unlocks 61 Cheats After Players Complete Main Story 
 Sportskeeda reports that killing Arnold awards the Hardened Criminal status. Beebom describes this outcome as contributing to Violent behavior in Jason's Criminal profile, while sparing Arnold contributes to Restrained behavior.
 Although these behavioral differences affect the character's criminal profile, the available walkthroughs indicate that neither decision creates a substantial change in the subsequent storyline. Arnold disappears from the game regardless of the player's selection.
 Choosing to spare Arnold produces an additional escape sequence in which he swims away from the docks. Jason subsequently returns to Brian and reassures him about the situation.
 Also Read 
 Rockstar Builds GTA 6 Around Romance and Criminal Behavior 
 During their conversation, Jason tells Brian that "Arnold will keep his mouth shut." The exchange concludes the confrontation and establishes that Brian considers the problem resolved, according to Sportskeeda.
 EGamers.io reports no monetary payment, additional items, or separate mission rewards for completing Hey Arnold! The mission primarily advances the Chapter 1 storyline rather than providing a financial incentive.
 Beebom also identifies the mission as mandatory for 100% completion and confirms that neither decision unlocks additional quests involving Arnold. The publication lists no newly unlocked items following the encounter.
 Also Read 
 GTA 6 Reveals Three Strip Club Locations in Vice City 
 Players can use Jason's special ability to slow down time during the vehicle pursuit, making it easier to respond to incoming attacks. Beebom also identifies shooting Arnold's vehicle tires as an alternative approach to stopping the chase earlier.
 Once the mission concludes, Island Dreams becomes available as the next Chapter 1 mission. Arnold's disappearance remains consistent across both available choices, although Jason's Criminal profile reflects the decision made at the docks.
